name: azerty-global-site

scripts.test:tester:all: node scripts/run-tester-e2e.js dist 4175 tester-chromium tester-firefox tester-webkit

scripts.cf:download:upload-msix: wrangler r2 object put azerty-global-downloads/AZERTY_Global_1.1.0.msixbundle --remote --file "../Fichiers d'installation/Application AZERTY Global (Windows Store-MSIX)/AZERTY_Global_1.1.0.msixbundle" --content-type application/msixbundle

scripts.cf:download:upload-windows: wrangler r2 object put azerty-global-downloads/AZERTY_Global_Windows.zip --remote --file "../../sources/legacy/AZERTY Global/2026/Fichiers d'installation/Installer AZERTY Global (Windows)/AZERTY_Global_Windows.zip" --content-type application/zip
scripts.cf:download:upload-macos: wrangler r2 object put azerty-global-downloads/AZERTY_Global_macOS.zip --remote --file "../../sources/legacy/AZERTY Global/2026/Fichiers d'installation/Installer AZERTY Global (macOS)/AZERTY_Global_macOS.zip" --content-type application/zip
scripts.cf:download:upload-linux: wrangler r2 object put azerty-global-downloads/AZERTY_Global_Linux.zip --remote --file "../../sources/legacy/AZERTY Global/2026/Fichiers d'installation/Installer AZERTY Global (Linux)/AZERTY_Global_Linux.zip" --content-type application/zip
